transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I suppose I'm here because of an incident at work. I was on a board call, and someone asked a minor question about the facility budget, and I just... I snapped. I lost my temper. It's not like me. That's not how I run my company or treat my people. So, I figured I should come in.
Has this kind of loss of temper happened to you before?
No. Not really. I mean... sure, I get frustrated sometimes, but... not like that. Like I said, it's just not me.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges that you feel compelled to act on?
No. I don't think so. Just... the temper thing, I guess. Nothing else really.
Do you find that you often have difficulty getting along with others?
No. I usually get along fine with people. I mean, I have to, right? Running a company... you have to manage relationships. It's just this one time.
Have you ever been in a physical fight?
No. Never. I'm a businessman, not a... I don't get into fights.
Have you ever had any problems with aggression outside of work?
No. Not at all. I don't have those kinds of problems. I just... go home and keep to myself.
Do you have any habits or rituals that you feel you need to do every day?
No. Not really. Just... my normal routine. Work, mostly. I don't do anything like that.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that disturb you?

Well... I don't know if I'd use the word disturbing. But... I guess. Sometimes I'll just be in the middle of a call, or... looking at some numbers, and... the blast. That fire by the loading area. It just jumps back into my head. It's just... like a bad film I didn't ask to see. I try to just push it away and get back to work, though.
Do you find yourself thinking about the fire by the loading area when you don't want to?
Yeah... like I just said. I don't ask for it to happen. I'll just be trying to get through a call or check the numbers, and it's just there. I'd rather just focus on my work.
Do you try to avoid things that remind you of the fire by the loading area?

I suppose. I've... I've been keeping away from the new building. Just staying clear of it. And... well, there's some paperwork. The mortgage folder, the safety reports... they're just sitting on my desk, unopened. Every time I reach for them... my stomach just drops. So I just leave them be.
How long have you been having these thoughts about the fire by the loading area?
About six days. Just... ever since the walkthrough. When the explosion happened.
Are there any specific activities or situations that you've been avoiding since the fire by the loading area happened?
I thought I just went over that. The new building... those files on my desk. Other than that, no. I don't know what else to tell you. I'm just trying to stick to my normal routine.
Have you experienced any moments where you felt like you were reliving the fire by the loading area?

I don't know if I'd call it reliving it. But... yeah, I guess. Sometimes I'll be right in the middle of a phone call, or just looking at some numbers. And the blast... that fire by the loading area... it just jumps back into my head. Like some bad film I didn't ask to see.
Are there any other things or situations, besides the new building and those files, that you've been avoiding since the fire happened?
No. Like I said, just the building and the files. I'm... I just want to get back to work. That's all.
Do you find yourself being easily startled lately?
Yeah... I suppose. If a door shuts hard, or... or the printer kicks on behind me, I jump. Just... like something went off again. It takes me a few minutes to get my hands steady after that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?
No... not really. I sleep fine. Just regular sleep, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
Have you been having difficulty concentrating lately?
No. I get my work done. I just... do what I need to do. It's fine.
Do you find yourself constantly on the lookout for potential dangers?
No... not really. I just go about my day. I'm not looking over my shoulder or anything like that.
How long have you been avoiding the new building and those files on your desk?

A while, I guess. I just... I've been keeping away from the new building. And the paperwork... the mortgage folder and those safety reports, they're just sitting there unopened. I don't know. The minute I reach for them, my stomach just drops. So I leave them be.
